pairs: May God have mercy on us
May he shine his countenance upon us,
and may he have mercy on us.
ut cognoscamus in terra viam tuam,
So may we know your way upon the earth,
Let the peoples confess to you,
Let all the peoples confess to you.
May the nations rejoice and exult.
For you judge the peoples with equity,
and you direct the nations on earth.
Let the peoples confess to you,
Let all the peoples confess to you.
The earth has provided her fruit.
et metuant eum omnes fines terræ.
and may all the ends of the earth fear him.
